<!-- Three boxes. Short is fine; honest is the point. -->

**Where did you get to?** (finished / stopped at step ___ — step IDs
like T3 or P5 are on every step)



**How long did it actually take?** (per chapter if you know it; "no
idea, longer than I expected" is real data)



**What should the next walker know?** (where the guide didn't match
what you saw · what confused you · what worked better than expected —
paste your debrief or your repo link here if you're sharing)
